Bulldoze (Japanese: じならし Smooth Over) is a damage-dealing Ground-type move introduced in Generation V.

It is:

  • TM78 from Generation V to Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon.
  • TM81 in Pokémon Sword and Shield.
  • TM83 in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl.
  • TM028 in Generation IX.

Effect

Bulldoze inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage. In Double Battles, it strikes both the opponents and the user's partner. In Triple Battles, it strikes all adjacent Pokémon.

If Grassy Terrain is in effect, Bulldoze deals only half the usual damage.

Generation VIII

Pokémon Legends: Arceus

Bulldoze can only hit one target, like all other moves in Pokémon Legends: Arceus. It also lowers the target's action speed.

Pokémon UNITE

In Pokémon UNITE, Bulldoze is Garchomp's second starting move. The user stomps the ground forcefully, dealing damage in a radius. After reaching level 7 as Gabite, the move is replaced by either Earthquake or Dragon Claw.

Description

Games Description
Conq. The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon's Speed is reduced.
MDGtI
SMD
MDRTDX 		It damages nearby enemies. It also lowers their Travel Speed.
